summary: Cincinnati Financial Corp filed an 8-K on August 25, 2026, disclosing that its Board authorized an additional 15 million shares repurchase under its existing program, supplementing the prior 15 million share authorization from January 2018. The buyback has no fixed expiration. This capital return action is the sole event; no deal terms or pricing were specified. An investor presentation was also furnished under Item 7.01. Watch for quarterly repurchase activity and remaining authorization disclosures in future 10-Q filings.
